name: What are common signs that my sliding door flashing needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my sliding door flashing needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of failing sliding door flashing include water stains or leaks around the door frame, dampness or mold growth on interior walls or flooring near the door, and damaged exterior siding or trim adjacent to the door. You might also notice swollen wood, peeling paint, or a musty odor. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent more extensive and costly water damage to your home's structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water stains, leaks, mold, dampness, or damaged siding around your sliding door as signs of failing flashing.
